_comment: Project settings for this repo, merged over ~/.claude/settings.json. The figma plugin brings its own MCP server, its tool roster and ten skills into every session's system prompt — measured at 3,552 tokens against an otherwise identical scratch project on 2026-08-15 (28,315 -> 24,763 prompt tokens for a one-word turn). None of it is reachable from a Rust TUI. Turned off here rather than globally: the design and VST work next door uses it. Delete this file to get it back. The two LSP plugins were measured in the same run and cost nothing here, so they are left alone.
_worktrees: wsp owns the working trees in this repo — `wsp checkout` makes them under .worktrees/<task>, on a branch named for the task, from local HEAD, with the stash guard installed. Claude Code's EnterWorktree makes its own under .claude/worktrees/ instead, and nothing in wsp can see one: not `wsp overlap`, not `wsp checkout --sweep`, not `wsp doctor`'s 'the tree for X is finished with'. Denied 2026-08-21 after a spawned agent reached for it — the tool fires on project instructions mentioning worktrees, and this project's handbook is made of them. A spawned agent's cwd is already inside its tree, so it needs neither mode. See agent-010.
_baseRef: Not covered by the deny above: subagent worktree isolation still creates trees, and 'fresh' — the default — branches them from origin/<default-branch>. Measured 2026-08-21: origin/master was f2f9bd5 and local master was 12a1e4e, 207 commits ahead, last fetch two days earlier. So the default would hand an agent a clean tree of last week's code and say nothing. 'head' is the only correct reading here.
